notes.title: Re:Turn 2 - Runaway is Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304960/d08555b66e22f24425014a4d14c19e134d941cd9.jpg[/img]


Hello, passengers,

After more than a year of working hard on our game, Re:Turn 2 - Runaway is finally live on Steam!
We have poured our souls into this game world and story over the past year, and we really hope you all enjoy playing it as much as we have enjoyed making it!



Have fun!
Red Ego team

PS. If you wish to report a bug or just chat with us about the game, visit our official [url=https://discord.gg/kgwb8fF]Discord server[/url].

notes.title: Re:Turn 2 - Runaway Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304960/2e399c44e3c13273f5ca6bb0ca47cd8987fe5eda.png[/img]


All aboard, dear passengers,

We're very excited to announce that the release date for Re:Turn 2 - Runaway has been set and will be available at the Nintendo Switch, Xbox and Steam on the 28th January 2022. Wishlist now and stay tuned for more info soon!

If you haven’t taken this train before, we highly recommend that you begin your journey with Re:Turn - One Way Trip, the first game where it all began… 


It’s the perfect time to experience it from the beginning while the next instalment creeps ever closer.


We hope to see you again soon. Perhaps on January 28th?

notes.title: Re: Turn 2 – Runaway: Demo is available now
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Returners![/h1]


Saki returns in the upcoming sequel Re:Turn 2 – Runaway, the sequel to Re:Turn –
One Way Trip. Download the demo today to see how her chilling story continues with all-new
voice lines, animations, and much more! We’ve been hard at work trying to bring you this
announcement and now, it’s finally here.

Download the demo today to get a sneak peek at Saki’s continued search for a way out of the nightmare train.
